afterImport: Try it on a copy of a note first: migrated inline fields are removed from the note body.

In **Settings → QuickAdd**, open the **Migrate Dataview properties** macro and click the cog on the **migrateDataviewToFrontmatter** step. Set **Properties to Migrate** to the fields you want moved (default `Reference, Related`); turn on **Migrate All Properties** only if you want every inline field moved.
Open the note you want to migrate and run **Migrate Dataview properties** from the command palette. Only that note changes.
